metadata.name: magicraft
metadata.description: Magicraft: onchain voxel survival on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: arm_chunk
docs: Re-arms a chunk's tick crank if it has fluid work or mobs and the crank is stale
(permissionless watchdog; chunk read-only).

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only: chain time, tick interval.

accounts.name: chunk
docs: (signs with its seeds). Writable: a stale re-arm rotates the task id epoch.

instructions.name: attack_mob
docs: Attacks the mob in slot `idx` of `chunk` (drops to inventory on death).

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only: seed (drops), params, chain time.

instructions.name: break_block
docs: Breaks a block within reach (cooldown = break time; drop to inventory, fluid enqueue).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Wallet or session key of `player`'s authority.

accounts.name: player
docs: Read-only; tied to `player_state` (see the module docs).

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only: params, chain time.

accounts.name: magic_program
docs: Arms the tick crank of edited chunks with fluid work (stale-gated).

instructions.name: callback_seed
docs: VRF callback: stores the seed once.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: close_chunk
docs: Closes an unedited, empty chunk + presence; refunds the payer Player.

accounts.name: player
docs: The chunk's payer; receives the refund. `mut` ⇒ must be delegated.

instructions.name: craft
docs: Crafts a recipe; stations are claimed by block position (+ chunk) and verified.

instructions.name: create_chunk
docs: Creates `Chunk (cx, cz)` (10 240 B, `gen_stage 0`) + its empty presence list,
sponsored by the Player. Same tx: `grow_chunk`.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Wallet or session key of `player`'s authority (fee payer; ER fees are 0).

accounts.name: player
docs: Sponsor (pays the ephemeral rent). `mut` ⇒ delegated on the ER.

accounts.name: world
docs: `chunk_count` is updated; the seed must be set.

accounts.name: chunk_n
docs: (`check_slots`).

accounts.name: player_state
docs: The signing player's `PlayerState` in `world` (identity checked in the handler):
allows creating the chunk the player currently stands in, see `check_adjacency`.

instructions.name: create_world
docs: Creates the ephemeral World (sponsored by the Player) and arms its day crank.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Wallet or session key (also the tx fee payer on the ER; fees are 0).

accounts.name: player
docs: Sponsor: pays the World's ephemeral rent. Delegated.

instructions.name: debug_cancel_tick
docs: Test hook (`localnet` builds only): cancels a chunk's tick task, header untouched.

instructions.name: debug_spawn_mob
docs: Test hook (`localnet` builds only): puts a mob of `kind` (full hp) at the FP feet
position `pos` into a free slot of the chunk holding it, and arms its crank;
`kind == 0` clears the chunk's mob slots.

accounts.name: player
docs: CPI re-derives it from the same seeds). Untyped because ownership moves
to the delegation program during the CPI.

instructions.name: eat
docs: Eats the food in `slot`.

instructions.name: grow_chunk
docs: Resizes the chunk to full size and writes stage-1 terrain (`gen_stage 1`).
Permissionless (sponsor = the chunk's payer Player).

accounts.name: player
docs: The chunk's payer (`chunk.payer`, checked): sponsors the resize, signing with its
stored PDA seeds. No user signature: the rent was reserved at `create_chunk`.

instructions.name: join_world
docs: Creates the player's `PlayerState` in the world at the spawn (sponsored by the Player).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Wallet or session key of `player`'s authority.

accounts.name: player
docs: Sponsor of the PlayerState rent. `mut` ⇒ delegated on the ER.

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only; the spawn must be set.

instructions.name: move_player
docs: Validates and applies one movement update (presence, damage, hunger). World read-only.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Wallet or session key of `player`'s authority.

accounts.name: player
docs: Presence rent sponsor (grow: pays, shrink/prune: refunded). `mut` ⇒ delegated.

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only: chain time and params. Never written (no write lock between movers).

accounts.name: player_state
docs: The mover's state in `world` (stored identity checked instead of a PDA derivation:
only `join_world` writes these fields, at the PDA of the pair it stores).

accounts.name: old_presence
docs: chunk (`presence_of`; `InvalidPresence` if missing or of another chunk).

instructions.name: place_block
docs: Places the block item of `slot` at a free, face-adjacent position within reach.
`remaining_accounts`: neighbour presence lists for border blocks (see `actions`).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Wallet or session key of `player`'s authority.

accounts.name: player
docs: Read-only; tied to `player_state`.

accounts.name: magic_program
docs: Arms the tick crank of edited chunks with fluid work (stale-gated).

instructions.name: populate_chunk
docs: Stage 2 (caves, ores, trees, animals). Permissionless; World read-only.

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only (the spawn is set by `set_spawn`).

accounts.name: magic_program
docs: Arms the tick crank when animals were placed.

instructions.name: request_seed
docs: Requests the world seed from the ER VRF queue (the creator's Player PDA pays).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Wallet or session key of `player`'s authority (any player, not only the creator:
the VRF output is unbiasable, so who pays does not matter).

accounts.name: player
docs: A delegated Player: the VRF payer (signs via its seeds; mut ⇒ delegated on the ER).

instructions.name: respawn
docs: Dead player only: back to the spawn with an empty inventory.

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only: spawn, chain time.

instructions.name: schedule_day_crank
docs: (Re)arms the World's day crank (permissionless, idempotent).

accounts.name: world
docs: Task authority (signs the Magic-program CPI with its PDA seeds). Writable: a re-arm
rotates the task id epoch (only when stale, so the write lock is rare).

instructions.name: select_slot
docs: Selects the held inventory slot.

instructions.name: set_spawn
docs: Sets the world spawn once from the populated chunk (0,0). Permissionless.

instructions.name: tick_chunk
docs: Crank target: one chunk tick (fluid, mobs, zombie spawn, idle / renewal).
Permissionless; never fails on recoverable state.

accounts.name: world
docs: Read-only: chain time, params, seed, time of day.

instructions.name: tick_day
docs: Crank target: re-anchors the clock and advances `time_of_day_ms`.

accounts.name: world
docs: No signer: cranked txs are signed by the validator; any World is fine to tick
(owner + discriminator checked by `Account`).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: ER: commit + undelegate the Player (step 1 of a withdrawal).

instructions.name: withdraw_base
docs: Base layer, after undelegation: transfer `lamports` to the wallet.

types.name: Player
docs: Per-wallet account. Holds the SOL that sponsors every ephemeral account the
player creates. Created, funded and delegated on the base layer.

fields.name: open_chunks
docs: Chunks this Player sponsors that are still open (`create_chunk` +1,
`close_chunk` −1). UI warnings only: `withdraw` is never blocked by it.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Padding for future fields (keeps the account size stable).

types.name: PlayerState
docs: A player's state inside one world. Ephemeral.

fields.name: player
docs: The Player PDA.

fields.name: move_state
docs: `core::physics::MoveState` bytes.

fields.name: exhaustion
docs: Food exhaustion accumulator (hunger drains one food point per threshold).

fields.name: inventory
docs: `core::inventory::Inventory` bytes.

fields.name: cx
docs: Current chunk.

fields.name: food_tick_ms
docs: Last hunger / regeneration step, chain ms.

fields.name: respawn_ms
docs: Chain ms of the last `respawn` (0 = never). Pending damage on an own presence entry
last seen before it hit the dead body and is dropped (`presence::upsert`).

types.name: TimeAnchor
docs: Chain time with ms resolution (`Clock::unix_timestamp` has 1 s): `chain_ms = anchor_ms +
(slot − anchor_slot) · ms_per_slot`.
- **Readers** (gameplay ixs) call [`Self::read`] on a read-only World: never writes.
- **The writer** is `tick_day` (every ~1 s) plus the initial anchor in `create_world`;
only it calls [`Self::reanchor`]. A re-anchor is **monotonic**: the new anchor is never
below the estimate readers saw at that slot, so fine readings never go backwards.
- Rate: `base_ms_per_slot` is measured from wall time over ≥ [`RATE_SPAN_MS`]
(sync point `sync_slot` / `sync_ms`).
- Offset: lagging by > [`REANCHOR_DRIFT_MS`] → jump forward to wall time; lagging
by more than [`RATE_DEADBAND_MS`] → run 1/8 fast; ahead by more than the deadband →
hold continuity and run 1/8 slow until wall time catches up (slew, never back).
`ms_per_slot` is the effective (slewed) rate readers use.
All-zero (`ms_per_slot == 0`) = not anchored yet.

fields.name: ms_per_slot
docs: Effective rate (base ± slew), ms per slot.

fields.name: base_ms_per_slot
docs: Measured rate, ms per slot.

fields.name: sync_slot
docs: Start of the current rate measurement: slot and wall ms.

types.name: World
docs: A world. Ephemeral, ≤ 10 240 bytes so `create_world` needs one ix.

fields.name: creator
docs: Wallet that created the world (`Player.authority`; seeds use it).

fields.name: spawn
docs: **Block** coordinates (not fixed-point) of the spawn feet block, set once by
`set_spawn` from chunk (0,0). `join_world` / `respawn` convert to the FP feet
position: `x·256 + 128, y·256, z·256 + 128` (block center).

fields.name: day_ticks
docs: Wrapping count of `tick_day` executions (diagnostics: crank liveness / rate).

fields.name: day_epoch
docs: Epoch mixed into the day crank's task id (`scheduler::task_id`); a stale re-arm
bumps it, so a squatted id is abandoned.

types.name: WorldParams
docs: Anchor/IDL mirror of `magicraft_core::physics::WorldParams`. Same fields in the
same order, so its Borsh bytes equal the core `to_bytes` layout (48 B).

fields.name: pad
docs: Must be 0 (`validate` rejects anything else).
